# Giacobbi's Cucina Citta

> Family-owned Italian-American restaurant at 59 Allen St. (at Franklin), Buffalo, NY 14202, in the Allentown neighborhood. Owned by cousins Billy and Mike Jacobbi, part of a Buffalo restaurant family whose restaurants include The Charlesgate (Transit Road, Williamsville), Giacobbi's Italian Oven & Rotisserie (4715 Transit Road, 1990s), Giacobbi's Trattoria (Main St. at Eggert) and Carmine's (Transit Road, closed after a 2015 fire). Open since May 2016.

## Essentials
- Phone: (716) 834-4000
- Hours: Wed–Sat bar 4:30pm, kitchen 5–10pm; Sun 4–9pm; closed Mon–Tue
- Reservations: https://resy.com/cities/buffalo-ny/venues/giacobbis
- Pickup ordering: https://ordering.chownow.com/order/20612/locations
- Delivery: DoorDash
- Parking: lot behind the restaurant, entered from Delaware next to Tempo; public after 6pm weekdays and all day weekends
- Catering: hot drop-off buffets at $18.75 per person (minimum 15; pick 2 entrées, 2 sides & 1 salad), half and full trays, and family-style party packages at the restaurant ($28 for 2 entrées, $33 for 3; minimum 12 adults)

## Known for
- Beans & Greens ($11), Calamari Della Casa ($17), Clams Casino (family recipe, $16), Crab & Shrimp Bisque (Taste of Buffalo award winner, $11)
- Lasagne ($20), Chicken Piccata ($24, best seller on the catering menu), Chicken Parmesan ($23), Steak Giacobbi ($28), Fruitti di Mare ($29), homemade gnocchi
- Friday fish fry: Icelandic haddock, fried or Italian baked
- Eggplant lasagne (a Carmine's recipe) and Tortellini Alfredo ala Giacobbi on the party and catering menus
